goal: Ersten strikt isolierten Browser-Maskeneditor-Slice als statische Loopback-Shell mit Komponentenpalette, festem 12-Spalten-Canvas und Vorschau bereitstellen; keine Persistenz und keine Datenbankzugriffe

guide_delta.summary: Der erste Browser-Editor zeigt Palette, 12-Spalten-Arbeitsfläche und Vorschau. Speichern und Datenbankzugriffe bleiben ausdrücklich außerhalb dieses Schritts.

direct_dependencies: existing GET-only database web runtime remains separate
tests_required: browser shell binds only to explicit loopback host
GET / returns HTML with component palette, exactly 12 grid column markers and preview region
palette exposes field, heading, section, note and separator kinds
non-GET methods return 405 and cannot mutate state
module source has no storage, repository, CatalogService, MaskTemplateStore or SQL dependency
tests_explicitly_not_run: full suite because this isolated UI shell does not touch frozen core
database regressions because no database dependency is introduced
template store tests because saving is explicitly out of scope
POST preview tests because POST /api/preview is reserved for the next gated slice
risks: the first slice is intentionally static and does not yet validate a draft through the model
interactive drag/drop must not bypass the canonical model in a later slice
non_changes: no database, repository, CatalogService, writer or SQL access
no change to existing provoware_db.web runtime
no POST endpoint in this slice
expected_side_effects: a standalone loopback-only editor shell can be rendered independently of the database web runtime
the next slice can add temporary POST /api/preview validation without widening the database boundary
